name: Joy Bangla Concert 2024 (8th edition, Chattogram)
organizer: Young Bangla / Centre for Research and Information (CRI)
notes: Eighth edition and the first held outside Dhaka, at Chattogram's MA Aziz Stadium, with nine bands. Reported running order: Lalon 6:15pm, Cryptic Fate 7:40pm, Nemesis 8:35pm, Chirkutt 9:35pm, Artcell 10:35pm, roughly 45 minutes per act. The ninth act, Chattogram's own Tirondaz, is named in coverage but too thinly documented elsewhere to catalogue as an artist record, so it is noted here rather than linked. The move out of Dhaka is the single clearest documented event in this dataset of the national festival circuit decentralising.
